description: Round, sort, deduplicate, and filter fractional fiducial positions before fitting and extrapolating a three-point quadratic baseline.

oracle.description: Subtracting offset 1 gives [4.5, 0.5, 2.5, 2.51, 8]; half-away-from-zero rounding produces [5, 1, 3, 3, 8], then sorting, deduplication, and range filtering leave [1, 3, 5]. Their window-size-one levels [0, 0, 20] define the quadratic baseline (5/2)(x-1)(x-3), including its right extrapolation.
